datasheet_identity.title: MMSZ5221B THRU MMSZ5267B Surface Mount Zener Diodes

extraction_notes: The MMSZ5228B row specifies VZ min 3.71 V, nominal 3.9 V, and max 4.10 V at IZT = 20 mA.
The p. 3 Zener Characteristics plots show family traces for 3.0 V and 4.3 V but no unambiguous MMSZ5228B 3.9 V trace; no curve points were extracted to avoid interpolation.
The p. 4 capacitance and leakage plots are generic family characteristics and do not provide an unambiguous MMSZ5228B-specific capacitance value or operating curve.
The table lists ZZT = 23 ohm for MMSZ5228B; the strict extraction schema has no zener-impedance field, so this value is preserved here rather than discarded.
Reverse recovery time is not published in the supplied datasheet.
omission_reason: No unambiguous MMSZ5228B-specific usable curve is present: the zener plot skips from 3.0 V to 4.3 V and the other plots are generic family characteristics. Capacitance and reverse recovery are also not available as part-specific required fields.
